Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms

Record Class SmsProperties

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms.SmsProperties
Record Components:
defaultRegion - ISO 3166-1 region assumed for a number typed without a country code (default US).
allowedCountries - ISO 3166-1 regions an SMS may be sent to (default US, ES, GB).
costPerCountryMicros - cost of one SMS by region; a region absent here costs defaultCostMicros.
defaultCostMicros - cost of an SMS to a region without its own cost (default 50000).
window - length of the spending window (default one hour).
windowCapMicros - spending allowed in a window (default 5000000).
dailyCapMicros - spending allowed in 24 hours (default 20000000).
verificationCodeLength - digits of the code that verifies a phone (default 6).
verificationCodeTtl - how long that code is valid (default 10 minutes).
verificationMaxAttempts - attempts allowed for that code (default 5).
ledgerRetention - how long the cost ledger keeps its rows, at least one day (default 2 days).
@ConfigurationProperties("authserver.sms") public record SmsProperties(String defaultRegion, Set<String> allowedCountries, Map<String,Long> costPerCountryMicros, long defaultCostMicros, Duration window, long windowCapMicros, long dailyCapMicros, int verificationCodeLength, Duration verificationCodeTtl, int verificationMaxAttempts, Duration ledgerRetention) extends Record
Settings of the SMS channel, bound from authserver.sms.* once and validated at startup. A missing (or zero, for a number) value takes its default, so the application starts without any setting.

Costs and caps are in micros of the billing currency (one millionth), so they stay integers.

  • Constructor Details

    • SmsProperties

      public SmsProperties(@DefaultValue("US") String defaultRegion, @DefaultValue({"US","ES","GB"}) Set<String> allowedCountries, Map<String,Long> costPerCountryMicros, @DefaultValue("50000") long defaultCostMicros, @DefaultValue("PT1H") Duration window, @DefaultValue("5000000") long windowCapMicros, @DefaultValue("20000000") long dailyCapMicros, @DefaultValue("6") int verificationCodeLength, @DefaultValue("PT10M") Duration verificationCodeTtl, @DefaultValue("5") int verificationMaxAttempts, @DefaultValue("P2D") Duration ledgerRetention)
      Applies the defaults and validates the settings.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a region is not an upper-case ISO code, a cost or cap is negative, a number or duration is negative, or the retention is shorter than one day.
